Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human CB1 receptor (CHEMBL218) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter by target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL218' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return the molecule identifier under the alias molecule_chembl_id and the canonical SMILES. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
